text: CVE-2026-98432 — Critical Linux Kernel Bug (CVSS 9.8). Remote unauthenticated attackers can crash servers, leak kernel memory, or get RCE via a use-after-free in IPv4 TCP handshake code. Affects virtually every Linux kernel since 4.4. Worst on systems with MPTCP listeners.

author: fireball_triada
text: Two AI-agent bugs disclosed in the last week share one design flaw: the safety switch could be flipped by the thing it was supposed to guard. AWS Strands Agents Tools, CVE-2026-115415: the environment tool accepted a change that disabled its own guardrail.

author: MilesBuilds
text: litellm 1.107.0 (Oct 21, PyPI and Docker) put cook.pth in site-packages, so every Python start ran a stealer for SSH keys, cloud creds and LLM keys. Removing litellm leaves it behind; check with find / -name cook.pth and rotate everything from a clean machine.
